ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Status) <> "Closed", OR( ISCHANGED( ClosedBy__c ), ISCHANGED( ClosedDate__c ), ISCHANGED( ClosureReason__c ) ), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ClosureReason__c ))), NOT(ISBLANK(ClosedDate__c )), NOT(ISBLANK(ClosedBy__c )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Application Status must be 'Closed' to update Closure Reason, Closed By and Closed Date.
